eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 5:49 AM on JUL 30, 2026 Effective until 1:49 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A SAFE Alert has been issued for Mesa Police Department. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Mesa Police Department is looking for Olga Batista, last seen on foot wearing  a brown shirt and blue jeans in the area of Country Club Drive and Rio Salado Parkway in Mesa, Arizona. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
